v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given a Friday and no events, when duration is 30 min, then no slot v2_human 15:00 is returned.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given a non Friday and no events when duration is 30 mins, then slots from 09:00 to 16:30 are returned in 15 min steps.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given any day and event that conflicts a candidate slot, when suggestions are compiled, that slot is excluded.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given any day, when a slot would start during 12:00-13:00, even it is excluded.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given any day and meeting duration <= 0, when suggestions are compiled, returned list is empty.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given any day and an event fully outside work hours, when suggestions are compiled, even availability is full.

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Time slots are evaluated every 15 mins.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: A 15 meeting buffer v2_human each event is blocked.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: Meeting duration must be positive integer [+].
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_6: On Fridays, latest allowed start is 15:00.

v2_human_g2_goal: The system computes valid meeting start times for a given day, using existing events and a requested duration. It returns slots that respect other events and workday.
v2_human_g2_input: events - List[Dict[str, STR]] of events w/start and end time strings in HH:MM format, meeting_duration: INT, number of minutes. Valid: POS time AND.
v2_human_g2_output: returns List[str] of valid start times formatted as HH:MM sorted ascending. returns empty list if no valid slots exist.
